<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Loading into Fort Forinthry is very intensive, potentially losing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dba">[[File:Dragon battleaxe.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/603979368850653216.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dba</nowiki>|<nowiki>dba</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> time. The following reduces load times:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reducing draw distance to Low</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turning off textures</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="amhej">[[File:Am-hej.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>|<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> actually does matter for a lot of damage. It's imperative to treat </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dragonclaw">[[File:Dragon claw.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/779048041088024606.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dragonclaw</nowiki>|<nowiki>dragonclaw</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as a switch, not </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="amhej">[[File:Am-hej.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1448070604937891921.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>|<nowiki>amhej</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as a switch.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you end up using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="overpower">[[File:Overpower.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>|<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> when Zemouregal has around 70k HP left, move </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gmaul">[[File:Granite maul.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/796989663051120640.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gmaul</nowiki>|<nowiki>gmaul</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="eofspec">[[File:Essence of Finality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>|<nowiki>eofspec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> up and use it with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="overpower">[[File:Overpower.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>|<nowiki>overpower</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to instantly KO Zemouregal. Alternatively, if you get an early </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;"
